name: LANtaFlex
note: LANtaFlex operates 7 numbered flex zones (501 Macungie, 502 Slate Belt, 503 Slatington/Walnutport, 504 Coplay/Egypt-Airport, 505 Coopersburg, 506 Bath-Hanoverville-Nazareth, 507 West/South Easton) in Lehigh and Northampton counties; CSV notes the largest zone is over 25 sq mi, so each zone is approximated as a ~25 sq mi circle centered on its named town and clipped to the two-county area rather than the town's own (much smaller) municipal boundary. Only one zone's size is public; the other six are sized the same for lack of individual figures, so this is a rough approximation. Zone 502 (Slate Belt) is described by road boundaries reaching the Northampton County line, not by a town list (https://lantabus.com/routes-and-schedules/route-502-slate-belt-flex/), so it is centered on Bangor, the Slate Belt's largest borough. Hanoverville (part of zone 506, an unincorporated place near Bath) has no separate Census place and is not separately resolvable; zone 506 is centered on Bath. Sources: https://lantabus.com/lantaflex/ , https://lantabus.com/routes-and-schedules/route-502-slate-belt-flex/
